TIPMTpmsAdaptationSettings.Description: Adjust the tire pressure at which the TPMS warning light will illuminate for a low tire-pressure condition. Sometimes takes up to 48h to fully apply settings. Overinflating for a while may help shorten this period, also check you spare tire pressure.
TIPMTpmsAdaptationSettings.Tip: TPMS sensors are timed and pressure-loss triggers. To properly read new data from the sensors. Vehicle driving is required before new setting are applied or TPMS light turns off.

WCMAdaptationSettings.Name: WCM - PCM Replace - Transfer secret key from WCM -> PCM
WCMAdaptationSettings.ImageDescription: Will only work with Bluetooth OBD adapters and it requires strong internet connection.
WCMAdaptationSettings.Description: The purpose of this function is to transfer the secret key stored in the WCM to the PCM when the PCM is replaced in service. Failure to transfer the secret key when the PCM is replaced will not have any effect on the VTA system functionality. The problem when not transferring the secret key will occur when the WCM is replaced and there is no secret key stored on the PCM. If this occurs then all of the vehicle keys will need to be replaced. Secret key transfer will only work when PCM Vin and WCM Vin are the same

JKAdaptationSettings.Name: Tire Size
JKAdaptationSettings.ImageDescription: Every tire is slightly different, sidewall numbers don't always match real measurements. Please measure tire height and round it to nearest 1/4 inch.
JKAdaptationSettings.Description: This feature allows you modify the programmed Tire Height. Correctly set tire height allows speedometer to show much more accurate values.  READ HELP BEFORE CONTINUE
JKAdaptationSettings.Tip:
Engine must be OFF, during adaptation. Ignition must be set to RUN. 
If speedometer doesn't work correctly after update. Remember to delete Trobuble codes on "Qucik Diagnostic" page to clear Check engine light. Engine must be OFF when clearing codes. 

Next try to cycle ignition Run->Off->Run and repeat procedure using 0.25'' larger tire size. Sometimes ECU requires 2-3 times to make things right. In case of any problems contact developer via OBD JScan Facebook page.
